signal: AmplifAI raised $33.7M in Series B led by CVS Health Ventures and was named a leading Auto QA/QM provider in the 2026 CMP Prism Report

email.body1:
Adrian, saw AmplifAI close $33.7M led by CVS Health Ventures and land in the 2026 CMP Prism Report.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market contact-center accounts in play than the team can cover before new targets land, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for AmplifAI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Adrian, quick follow-up for AmplifAI.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and recovery eats the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings AmplifAI needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps to close it.
email.body3:
Adrian, last bit of proof for AmplifAI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how AmplifAI's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Adrian, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters right after a raise, and I know the fundraise-to-scale stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to AmplifAI either way.
